name: Star Wars No
look: Two stacked widescreen frames from The Empire Strikes Back. Top: Darth Vader in his black helmet stands against a dark shaft dotted with lights. Bottom: a battered Luke Skywalker, played by Mark Hamill, clings to a metal pole and screams in anguish.
use: A shocking truth and the denial that follows. Vader's panel gets the unwelcome revelation, and Luke's panel gets the anguished no, or a horrified refusal to accept it.
examples: I ate the last slice of your birthday cake
describe: darth vader telling luke something and luke screaming no
luke skywalker hanging on and yelling noooo
vader reveals he is luke's father
space movie scene where luke screams in shock
black helmet villain and a beaten young hero shouting no
origin: Darth Vader and Luke Skywalker in the 1980 film The Empire Strikes Back, when Vader reveals he is Luke's father.
